name: Photon token core
layer: 1 — shared by both realizers (DOM/CSS on web, Photon on native) of the write-once eQuantic.UI.Components
colorApi: Color(byte R, byte G, byte B, byte A) — byte alpha — plus FromRgb, FromRgba, WithOpacity(float), Transparent/Black/White. ColorToken(Color Light, Color Dark) with a one-arg ctor for same-in-both-modes, Resolve(ThemeMode) and WithOpacity(float). There is no Rgba type and no ColorToken.Of(uint, uint).
modeFree: The theme never knows the active mode. Web emits light-dark(light, dark); native resolves at paint via token.Resolve(ThemeMode).
verifiedBy: DesignTokenTests (shipped) — asserts >= 4.5:1 for every OnBase/Base and OnSubtle/Subtle pair in both modes, and >= 7.0 for primary and secondary text.

unit.note: 1 unit = 1dp on mobile, 1px on web. Never re-derive per platform.

surfaceHighlight.note: Top-edge highlight over a surface — translucent so it composites over whatever is beneath it (Skeleton shimmer, raised edges). Decorative: no contrast requirement.

base.note: brand green #80B85C darkened for AA in light mode

tertiary.note: Photon has no distinct tertiary palette; it reuses Info (the contrasting accent) five-tuple for five-tuple.

rules: Components reference semantic tokens only — raw hex fails review.
Base colors are fills for onBase text; never use Base as text on Surface (Link is the audited exception).
Disabled is not a color pair: 38% opacity group over the resolved style.
Pressed is a real token (fill swap), not an overlay layer.

space.note: There is no Space.Base — the scale is S1..S16 plus Gutter.
rules: No margin property — parents own spacing via gap and padding.

shapeScale.note: IAppTheme.Shape(ShapeScale) returns these; the Radius constants are the same ladder by short name.

typography.api: TypeStyle(float Size, float LineHeight, FontWeight Weight, float Tracking, float MaxScale, bool Mono = false) — note the order. FontWeight { Regular=400, Medium=500, SemiBold=600, Bold=700, ExtraBold=800 }. v1.1 audit: Mono is the monospaced face, on the STYLE (measurer, rasterizer and raster cache all key on it). TypeRole : byte has TEN members — TitleSmall = 7, LabelSmall = 8, Overline = 9 are the dense desktop rungs (Theme/Typography.cs).

titleSmall.note: v1.1 · TypeRole 7 — card headers: title weight at body size

labelSmall.note: v1.1 · TypeRole 8 — dense meta: status rails, inspector read-outs

overline.note: v1.1 · TypeRole 9 — the tracked, uppercase eyebrow

typography.atlasWhitelist: 8–40 in 0.5 steps — scaled sizes snap to the nearest entry

elevation.alphaNote: Dark alphas are explicit SDK values, NOT a flat offset from light (+0.35 on level 1, +0.36 on 2–5).
rules: In dark mode levels 1–2 also require a 1dp Border.

motion.api: Motion is NAMED — spec animations as roles, never as raw milliseconds. TransitionSpec(StyleChannels Channels, float DurationMs = Motion.BaseMs, float DelayMs = 0) with Easing = Curve.Standard; factories Of(StyleChannels, MotionSpec), Colors(durationMs = Motion.FastMs), All(durationMs = Motion.BaseMs).

curves.note: Curve is exactly (X1,Y1,X2,Y2) — three beziers. v1.1 audit: SpringSpec exists as a TYPE (see spring) but nothing consumes it; Curve.Spring and Motion.Settle do not exist.

styleChannels.note: Filters = element + backdrop blur; Size = the width/height/max-bounds morph channel.

motion.springRequest: Spring BEHAVIOR remains REQUEST: SpringSpec shipped as a type (see spring) but is consumed by NOTHING — no realizer reads it, no Curve.Spring or Motion.Settle exists. Gesture release still runs releaseGlide. Do not spec springs yet.

spring.type: SpringSpec(float Stiffness, float Damping, float Mass)
spring.status: v1.1 audit: TYPE SHIPPED, UNCONSUMED — behavior still REQUEST

releaseGlide.use: gesture release — sheet detent snap, swipe settle, drag glide-back, dismiss: pick the target from position + velocity, then glide there
releaseGlide.note: Sanctioned interim (v1.1 audit). Lives in the gesture system, deliberately NOT a Curve constant.

roles.note: There is no settle/spring role — gesture release uses releaseGlide (sanctioned interim); see springRequest.

duration.note: The scale is 100 / 200 / 300 only — nothing sits between the rungs.

rules: Reduce Motion replaces movement with a 120ms crossfade (Motion.ReducedCrossfadeMs).

icon.note: SDK names — Md is 24, the dense step is 20. Do not rename.

touch.note: Visual bounds may be smaller; hit-slop expands symmetrically — on a FINGER. A pointer lands where it is aimed, so a Compact target is its own visual bounds and no slop is added: see controlMetrics.*.compact.hit (26 / 32 / 40 / 56) and density.note, which this sentence used to contradict. Web expresses the same condition as @media (pointer: coarse). There is no ControlMetrics record — ButtonStyles.Metrics returns a named tuple.

controlMetrics.api: Sizing.Height / PaddingX / LabelSize / HitTarget(SizeVariant, Density density = Density.Comfortable) — Gap, Icon and Radius take no density. ButtonStyles.Metrics(SizeVariant, Density = Comfortable) returns the named tuple (Height, PadX, Gap, LabelSize, IconSize, Radius, Hit) — there is no ControlMetrics record. Components read context.Density; DisabledOpacity lives on IAppTheme, not on Sizing.

density.note: A property of the TARGET, never of the call site — touch keeps the §08 hit contract, pointer tightens chrome. Calling Sizing.*(size) alone silently gets Comfortable everywhere.

controlMetrics.compactValuesSource: read from the shipped Sizing switches (Theme/Tokens.cs @ 2026-08-12) — never re-derived
controlMetrics.openQuestion: Under Compact the SDK collapses the 48dp hit expansion to hit = visual height (HitTarget returns Height), contradicting §03 'touch targets ≥ 48dp even when the visual is smaller'. Either §03 gains an explicit pointer-density exception or the SDK is in violation — OPEN, do not silently resolve.

variants.note: Tertiary is last and aliases Info.

sizeVariants.note: Named SizeVariant — a bare Size collides with SizeValue (layout sizing).

hover.mechanism: DERIVED — the variant five-tuples keep Base/OnBase/Pressed/Subtle/OnSubtle; there is no Hover slot

derivation.filled: hover fill = midpoint(Base, Pressed); text stays OnBase. Web emits color-mix(in srgb, Base 50%, Pressed); native desktop computes the same midpoint at paint.
derivation.quietOutlineGhost: hover fill = SurfaceSubtle — the fill Pressed already uses

rules: Hover clears when the pointer leaves the window.
Nothing may exist only behind a hover.
hover.sdkStatus: LANDED — VariantColors.Hover derives Base→Pressed at the token level (ColorToken.MidpointWith), so both realizers paint the identical value and neither computes it at the call site. The five-tuple is unchanged: Hover is derived, never a sixth slot.
